in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male ICR (Crl:CD1), obtained at 5 weeks old, 6 weeks old at study
in_vivo_species.quote: Male ICR mice were obtained from Charles River Laboratories (Yokohama, Japan) at 5 weeks old

in_vitro_detail: GLP-1 agonist activity measured as cAMP production in RIN-m5F cells using a cAMP-Glo Max Assay kit; EC50 values determined.

agents.name: CH70-EDA-(LMDS)-GLP-1C (conjugate 1)
agents.sequence: HGEGTFTSDVSSYLEGQAAKEFIAWLVKGRC (GLP-1C = [Gly8, Cys37]GLP-1(7-37); conjugated to chondroitin CH70 via EDA and the sulfo-LMDS heterobifunctional linker)
agents.sequence_source: METHODS - Peptides: 'GLP-1C (HGEGTFTSDVSSYLEGQAAKEFIAWLVKGRC) was purchased from Scrum Inc.'
agents.chemical_identifier: sulfo-LMDS = N-[lambda-maleimidododecanoyloxy]-sulfosuccinimide ester (C12); CH70 Mw/Mn = 69 kDa/42 kDa
agents.group_n_quote: Male ICR mice (6 weeks old, n = 3) received iv injections of GAG-conjugated GLP-1C at 1 mg/kg
agents.dose: 100 nmol/kg (0.33 mg/kg as GLP-1C peptide) s.c.; 1 mg/kg as GLP-1C peptide i.v. in the screening study
agents.dose_route_quote: Conjugates were injected into Crl:CD1 (ICR) mice subcutaneously at 100 nmol/kg (0.33 mg/kg as GLP-1C peptide)
agents.half_life: T1/2 elim = 32.9 h (s.c., 100 nmol/kg); T1/2 elim = 23.4 h (i.v., 1 mg/kg screening)
agents.pk_quote: 1 remained in circulation much longer (T1/2 elim = 32.9 h) than liraglutide (T1/2 elim = 8.9 h). The Cmax values of 1 and liraglutide were 168.8 and 202.0 ng/mL, respectively. The Tmax values were 24 and 6 h. The AUC0-inf values were 8629.5 and 4084.3 ng/mL h. Mean residence times (MRT) were 44.8 and 15.5 h. The paper labels the parameter 'T1/2 elim' throughout, so the phase is taken from the parameter name. An earlier i.v. screening value is given separately: 'the EC50 and T1/2 elim were 6.1 nM and 23.4 h, respectively'. No absorption half-life or absorption rate constant is reported anywhere in the body.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - PK of CH-Conjugated GLP-1C Peptide, Conjugate 1

agents.dose_route_quote: PK studies were performed with CH90-EDA-(LMDS)-GLP-1C (conjugate 2) at 300 nmol/kg (1 mg/kg as GLP-1C peptide)
agents.pk_quote: Table 1 header row: 'T1/2 elim (h) 25.3 30.3 33.6 25.8'; the first two columns are conjugate 2 i.v. then s.c. The parameter is explicitly named 'T1/2 elim' (a half-life in hours), not a rate constant, so it is recorded as an elimination half-life. Body text: 'the biological profile (EC50 = 9.9 nM, T1/2 elim = 25.3 h after iv injection) of 2 was very similar to that of 1'. Table 1 also gives V 182 mL/kg (i.v.) and V/F 1016 mL/kg (s.c.), Cl 5.0 and Cl/F 23.4 mL/h/kg, MRT 14.1 and 46.0 h, and bioavailability 21%.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma immunoreactive GLP-1 levels after sc injection of liraglutide and CH70-EDA-(LMDS)-GLP-1C (conjugate 1) at 100 nmol/kg
concentration_time_figure.note: Figure 5 plots plasma immunoreactive GLP-1 concentration versus time after s.c. and i.v. dosing of conjugates 1 and 2 and liraglutide; Figure 4B plots plasma levels after i.v. injection of CH10-CH140-EDA-(KMUS)-GLP-1C and liraglutide; Figure 7A,B plot plasma levels after i.v. and s.c. injection of HPN conjugates 3 and 4. Figures 4A and 4C plot derived T1/2 elim values, not concentration versus time.

bioanalytical_method: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (active) ELISA kit (Millipore) with fluorescence detection; PK parameters calculated with Phoenix WinNonlin v6.4
bioanalytical_quote: The concentration of immunoreactive GLP-1 in the plasma samples was quantified using a glucagon-like peptide-1 (active) ELISA kit (Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany).
notes: All half-lives in this paper are explicitly labelled 'T1/2 elim' (elimination half-life, in hours), so the phase comes from the parameter name rather than inference. No absorption half-life and no rate constant (ka/ke) is reported anywhere in the body. Cmax/tmax are reported for conjugate 1 and liraglutide in the text and for conjugates 2 and 3 in Table 1; tmax is listed as 'NA' for the i.v. arms. Screening series not enumerated as individual agents: the body reports that a large panel of CH conjugates varying in CH size (CH10-CH140), amine modifier (EDA/HDA/BAMB/BAMC) and linker (AMAS, BMPS, GMBS, EMCS, HMCS, KMUS, LMDS, NMTS, OMHS) gave 'significantly prolonged half-lives (8.1-38.5 h)', reported only as a range plotted in Figure 4A; individual values are not printed, so only the specifically quantified conjugates are listed as agents. Group sizes: n = 3 for PK, n = 6 for IPGTT/PD. Discussion mentions 'consecutive iv injections of CH in rats at 100 mg/kg for 28 days' and that 'CH circulates in humans' as preliminary/unpublished observations with no data or design given; rat and human are therefore NOT listed in in_vivo_species or as clinical/in vivo study types. Curation rule applied: the intraperitoneal glucose challenge (1 g/kg) used for the IPGTT is a procedural probe and is documented here rather than listed as an agent. Plasma ELISA is bioanalysis of in vivo samples and was not classified as an ex vivo study type.
